issue_context.title: core-2021.6.2 breaks Samsung Smart TV
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The state of the Samsung TV isn't reported correctly anymore after upgrading to 2021.6.2
Since the upgrade the state is always "Unavailable". It used to be "On" and "Off".
Reverting to 2021.6.1 solves the issue.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

Core-2021.6.2

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

Core-2021.6.1

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Samsung Smart TV

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/samsungtv/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
No, no error messages involved
```


### Additional information

_No response_
